notes.title: Baradroid – Lost Data: Director’s Cut is now available — and it’s free
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323850/c87f1e4da044277cfd149b03d7f6fc8083bf8be1.png[/img]

After the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952750/Baradroid__A_Gay_Visual_Novel/]Baradroid[/url], many players were left frustrated.

The game had been announced with a much broader scope — and while we did our best with what we had, the final version didn’t match the expectations we had set.

We had promised to release Caleb’s route, which was fully planned and partially developed — but in the end, it didn’t make it into the final game.

Over time, with more setbacks and reflection, we came to understand that there’s no reason to keep pushing a project that faced so many challenges and ultimately left players disappointed.

Still, we didn’t want to walk away in silence.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749520/Baradroid__Lost_Data_Directors_Cut/]Baradroid—Lost Data: Director’s Cut[/url] is now available as free DLC. It features fully voiced scenes from the original demo—a feature later cut so we could move forward to development.

[b]Please note:[/b]
There is no new gameplay, and [b]NSFW scenes are not voiced.[/b] This release focuses entirely on narrative moments from the early version of the game.

[b]This is not a continuation — it’s a farewell.[/b] A final gesture of care and honesty for everyone who believed in Baradroid.

We also want to thank the voice actors who gave these scenes their emotional depth. Bringing these characters to life wouldn’t have been possible without their incredible work. Even in a small release like this one, their performances added depth, emotion, and personality to each scene.

Thank you to each of you:

— Aife_VA for giving Morgan such a sharp, emotional presence.
— Shay-Ki Fullalove for bringing strength and subtlety to Ayden’s synthetic soul.
— Quenton Jones for capturing Niko’s charm with authenticity and heart.
— LilyYasudaVA for voicing Caleb with softness, mystery, and depth.
— And to Zip, our quirky synthetic voice created with ElevenLabs — you still have personality, even without a heart.

We’re genuinely grateful. Your work means the world to us.

Thank you our community too for supporting our work. This one’s for you.

— Male Doll Team

notes.title: You spoke, and we llisted! Caleb's Route is under development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First, THANK YOU to EVERYONE who supported the game, especially kitsune37, Aarden, and Parson Ova, who provided honest feedback. We're glad you all tried to understand how hard it was for us to make this game happen, and we are thrilled you want to know more about Baradroid!

After the game launch, considering we couldn't deliver everything we wanted in the first place, we thought many of you wouldn't support us. However, the sales have been performing better than we expected, and [b]the messages you sent us praising us for being honest make us believe an honest relationship is the best way for us to keep doing our work[/b]. 

To thank you all, [b]we decided to deliver what we would have had in the game without the Kickstarter campaign - a game with Ayden's and Caleb's routes[/b]. All CGs from Caleb's route were drawn before the campaign attempt, and we had to discard them to deliver the game, so we'll bring them back and write his route. 

In the following days, the writer will return to work on the project, and we will keep you posted on the news! Thank you so much for being so supportive. We weren't expecting so much love around us!

Victor Invicta
Founder of Male Doll

notes.title: READ THIS! Kickstart cancelation, Digital Rewards and more.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Two years after Baradroid's announcement, we released its first build. It was a challenging journey to make one of our most significant projects, and I want to share a few things with you all. I hope they help you understand some changes we made to complete the project.

When we started it, we made a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952750/Baradroid__A_Gay_Visual_Novel/]Steam page[/url] as fast as possible. We aimed to collect wishlists while we completed under-development projects, and then we would start Baradroid. Things started pretty well. We had a fantastic writer on the team; the project would have more than 100k words, Live 2D sprites (as Fallen Bear), five routes; it would be a BIG project!

However, after the first weeks with the Steam page available, we noticed the wishlist rate wasn't as good as we expected. We could be sad about it, but we decided to take risks. We reduced Baradroid's scope to make it would be fully voiced! We planned to make a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maledollstudio/baradroid-a-gay-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url] for that because, after years of trying to make one, we could do that! (Last year, Male Doll found a US company, and now we can launch a Kickstarter.)

[b]We prepared A LOT OF DIGITAL REWARDS: a fantastic wardrobe system in which you can choose d**** for the androids, change their clothes, wear accessories, and have pets[/b] - as we can check on the images below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323850/a1621cd21dcd31d50208a148a09a774cbd87679c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323850/1a78cf3a3582f06364424a82755ff9d607a9e944.gif[/img]

The page was accepted by Kickstarter; the game was almost done, and then... A bureaucratic issue popped up. Kickstarter requested a new document for me (Victoria) to be able to receive the payment. It's not a big deal, and my accounting requested it a few months ago, but the point is that the document can be delivered tomorrow in 1 week, 1 month, a semester. There is no forecast for this.

If we were a big company, we could wait for that, but we aren't. Also, we are working on many things and want to present them to you, but we need to close this chapter. Baradroid made us learn A LOT of things, and we put our heart into it. [b]The game is 100% done and will be launched next month.[/b]

[b]All digital rewards we made will be sold as a DLC.[/b]

Thank you, everyone, for being patient and not giving up on this project. We hope we fulfill your expectations. If you haven't wishlisted it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952750/Baradroid__A_Gay_Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url] yet, please do it! It helps us reach new players a lot.

notes.title: Activating Kickstarter Rewards
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Today we're going to explain how the in-game rewards activation will work.

[b]Step 1:[/b] Our backers will receive a form through Kickstarter with information to fill out, such as the chosen rewards and their Friend Code.

[b]Step 2:[/b] To obtain this Friend Code and complete the form, access the 'Friends & Chat' tab located in the bottom right corner of the Steam home screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323850/e756c018b3f71b03b861ec833abaa2820e824307.png[/img]

[b]Step 3:[/b] With the friends list open, click on 'Add a Friend' (+).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323850/f843b5b9b78671b51206cf33f8a7edb82b386bd7.png[/img]

[b]Step 4:[/b] The number shown on screen is your Friend Code. Copy this number and paste it in the designated field on the form.

[b]Example:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323850/b340e05cbb8f4b8629d32843d8a8c15a22e81787.png[/img]

[b]Step 5:[/b] Make sure you've provided all the necessary information on the form and then submit it.

When it's released, your rewards will already be available in-game!

If you have any other questions about the rewards, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Follow [url=Baradroid on Kickstarter]Baradroid on Kickstarter[/url]!

Male Doll Team
